label: SYNTHETIC-DATA EXPERIMENT: metrics reflect patterns deliberately embedded by the synthetic generator. They are not evidence of real customer behavior or of real-world recommendation effectiveness.

statistical_design.within_seed: paired percentile bootstrap; resampling unit = customer-task case (window) or customer (next-event, cluster bootstrap); describes variation inside one dataset
statistical_design.across_seed: each seed's test mean or paired difference is one observation; mean, sample SD, Student-t 95% interval over seeds; describes variation across independent synthetic datasets of one profile at fixed size; within-seed CIs are not pooled
statistical_design.not_covered: variation across profiles, population sizes, window lengths, generator versions, or any real population; profiles are not compared with intervals
statistical_design.seed_sharing: the same seed list is used for every profile, so customer attributes and consent are identical across profiles for a given seed; only behavior differs

population_note: Results cover only customers / target events with sufficient consent-permitted same-task history (min_history=1). Cold start is excluded and counted, not evaluated.
